title: Bitbucket PR Reviewer - AI Code Review Automation
description: AI-powered automated code review system for Bitbucket Cloud pull requests using Claude AI, with webhook-driven architecture and queue-based processing.
longDescription: An intelligent code review automation system that analyzes Bitbucket Cloud pull requests using Claude AI. Features a webhook-driven architecture that eliminates polling, queue-based processing with Redis for scalability, and dual commenting system with both inline and summary reviews. Includes configurable review guidelines, enterprise-grade security with signature verification and rate limiting, and distributed locking to prevent race conditions.
